title: Renderer plugins are picked by kind with selectRendererPlugin
detail: The renderer for a kind is the mounted plugin named in `DEFAULT_PLUGIN_BY_KIND`, otherwise the first mounted plugin serving the kind, otherwise `RendererError("no_plugin_for_kind")`. The tenant override through a `rendererPluginByKind` config key was documented, but no caller ever passed a lookup and no such key was registered, so it is removed together with its parameter. `createRendererFoundationApi`, the type `RendererFoundationApi` and `requireRendererFoundation` are removed; no code read `rendererFoundation` from the extra context.
migration: Replace `createRendererFoundationApi(collectRendererPlugins(registry)).createRendererForTenant({ tenantId, kind })` with `selectRendererPlugin(collectRendererPlugins(registry), kind)` and drop a `rendererFoundation` entry from `extraContext`.

title: document-pdf requests name a template, the response carries fileName
detail: The document-pdf payload is { slug, locale, variables } instead of ready HTML in content. The response has a fileName, RendererContext gets an optional filesForTenant (file access per tenant) and RendererError has the new code unavailable for a renderer backend that cannot be reached.
migration: Callers that sent `payload: { content }` switch to a document-pdf template and pass slug, locale and variables (money-horse credit-schedule-pdf follows in #621); renderer-pdf callers pass slug and locale too. The enterprise package @cosmicdriftgamestudio/kumiko-renderer-puppeteer-client no longer builds against these types and is replaced by @cosmicdrift/kumiko-renderer-puppeteer-client.

title: renderer plugins can preview a document
RenderRequest kind mail replaces mail-html
detail: RenderRequest and RenderResponse use kind mail with a MailPayload ({ slug, locale, variables, unsubscribeUrl? }) and a response of { subject, html, text, previewText? }. The export MailHtmlPayload is removed; use MailPayload. The default plugin name for kind mail stays mail-html. RendererContext gains an optional config accessor that plugins use for tenant locale, currency and branding.
migration: Replace kind mail-html with mail in createRendererForTenant and render calls, pass { slug, locale, variables } instead of content/contentFormat, and read the subject from the response instead of building it yourself. Pass ctx.config in the RendererContext to get tenant locale, currency and branding.

title: renderer-simple, MailBranding and renderer kind "notification" are removed
detail: Every mail is a stored template rendered by renderer-mail-html now. renderer-simple (createRendererSimpleFeature, simpleRenderer, createSimpleRenderer, RendererSimpleOptions, mail blocks with LocalizedText, MailBadge, MailChip, MailStage, MailStageState and MailTone), the MailBranding type, the renderer kind "notification" and AuthMailContent are gone. NotificationRenderer and RendererInput are removed from delivery, and createChannelEmailFeature no longer takes a renderer option. The type NotificationPayload is removed from renderer-foundation. The template-resolver keeps "notification" only as a stored kind so legacy rows stay readable; RENDER_KINDS is mail, document-pdf and image-snapshot.
migration: Remove createRendererSimpleFeature() and any renderer or mailBranding option from your feature list and createChannelEmailFeature call. An r.notification that is sent by email needs template + meta (or localizedTemplate) and variables; the sections/header/footer data it carried is replaced by template variables. Branding (logo, footer) now comes from the tenant branding config and the mail layout of renderer-mail-html. Mount template-resolver, renderer-foundation and @cosmicdrift/kumiko-renderer-mail-html (composeRendererStack() mounts all of them) and run seedNotificationTemplates at boot. Existing template rows with kind "notification" are no longer rendered; re-create them as kind "mail" or archive them.

title: MailPayload.draft renders an unsaved mail template; RendererContext.db also accepts a TenantDb
Bundled extension points (renderer, deliveryChannel, mailTransport, inboundMailProvider, subscriptionProvider) are typed
migration: r.useExtension options for renderer ({ kinds, render }), deliveryChannel ({ mode, resolve, render?, send, accept? }), mailTransport (MailTransportPlugin), inboundMailProvider (InboundMailProviderPlugin) and subscriptionProvider (SubscriptionProviderPlugin) are now type-checked and required; renderer and deliveryChannel registrations do not pass name (it comes from the entity name). Prefer the new constants RENDERER_EXTENSION, DELIVERY_CHANNEL_EXTENSION and MAIL_TRANSPORT_EXTENSION over string literals. A registration whose options do not match the plugin shape now throws with the entity name when channels or renderers are collected.
